'''Heloan Yagen''' was the wife of [[Bovo Yagen]]. The [[Heloan Yagen (planet)|fifth]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Bovo Yagen system/Legends|Bovo Yagen system]] was named after her.
